cards.example_en: Some students claim that the test was too hard.
cards.example_zh: 有些学生声称这次考试太难了。

cards.example_en: The audience began to clap.
cards.example_zh: 观众开始鼓掌。

cards.example_en: We classify leaves by shape during the biology field trip.
cards.example_zh: 生物实地考察时，我们按形状给叶子分类。

cards.example_en: The clerk checked my student card.
cards.example_zh: 职员查看了我的学生证。

cards.example_en: The shopkeeper greeted a regular client by name.
cards.example_zh: 店主喊着名字招呼一位老主顾。

cards.example_en: Wipe the table with a clean cloth.
cards.example_zh: 用干净的布擦桌子。

cards.example_en: A clown made balloon animals for children at the fair.
cards.example_zh: 小丑在集市上为孩子们做气球小动物。

cards.example_en: Hens cluck loudly when someone walks near their wooden coop.
cards.example_zh: 有人走近木鸡舍时，母鸡会大声咯咯叫。

cards.example_en: Good cooperation helped our group finish the project on time.
cards.example_zh: 良好的合作帮助我们小组按时完成了项目。

cards.example_en: The old train used coal.
cards.example_zh: 那列旧火车用煤。

cards.example_en: A cockroach ran across the kitchen floor and hid under the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 一只蟑螂跑过厨房地板，躲到了冰箱底下。

cards.example_en: She bought a cold coke after the long bike ride home.
cards.example_zh: 长途骑车回家后，她买了一杯冰可乐。

cards.example_en: This collection of ghost stories is the favourite book in our class.
cards.example_zh: 这本鬼故事合集是我们班最喜欢的书。

cards.example_en: Use this comb if your hair gets messy in the wind.
cards.example_zh: 要是风把头发吹乱了，就用这把梳子。

cards.example_en: The combination of rice and grilled fish is my favourite lunch.
cards.example_zh: 米饭配烤鱼的组合是我最喜欢的午餐。

cards.example_en: Art students combine red and blue to get purple.
cards.example_zh: 美术班的学生把红色和蓝色调成紫色。

cards.example_en: We laughed all through the comedy that the drama club put on.
cards.example_zh: 戏剧社演的那出喜剧，我们从头笑到尾。

cards.example_en: The commercial centre is near the station.
cards.example_zh: 商业中心在车站附近。

cards.example_en: The sports committee moved the final to the indoor court.
cards.example_zh: 体育委员会把决赛改到了室内球场。

cards.example_en: Poor communication made the relay team drop the baton twice.
cards.example_zh: 交流没做好，接力队两次把接力棒掉在了地上。

cards.example_en: A quick comparison showed the bus pass costs less than daily tickets.
cards.example_zh: 简单一比较就发现，公交月票比每天买票更便宜。

cards.example_en: Bring your compasses tomorrow so we can draw circles in maths.
cards.example_zh: 明天把圆规带来，数学课上我们要画圆。

cards.example_en: She won first prize in the speech competition.
cards.example_zh: 她在竞赛中获得一等奖。

cards.example_en: Don't complain about the homework.
cards.example_zh: 不要抱怨作业。

cards.example_en: I filed a complaint because the locker room had no hot water.
cards.example_zh: 更衣室没有热水，我为此提交了投诉。

cards.example_en: Her coach gave her a compliment after the difficult match.
cards.example_zh: 那场艰难的比赛之后，教练称赞了她。

cards.example_en: The composer visited our school and played his new song.
cards.example_zh: 那位作曲家来到我们学校，演奏了他的新歌。

cards.example_en: Hand in your composition tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 明天交作文。

cards.example_en: Exam results concern my parents more than sports scores.
cards.example_zh: 我父母更关注考试成绩，而不是体育分数。

cards.example_en: These results let us conclude that the plant needs more sun.
cards.example_zh: 这些结果让我们得出结论：这种植物需要更多阳光。

cards.example_en: Write a short conclusion at the end.
cards.example_zh: 在结尾写一个简短的结论。

cards.example_en: The conductor raised his hands and the orchestra began to play.
cards.example_zh: 指挥举起双手，管弦乐队开始演奏。

cards.example_en: She sounded confident when she introduced the guest speaker.
cards.example_zh: 她介绍演讲嘉宾时，声音听起来很自信。

cards.example_en: Wildlife conservation needs everyone's help.
cards.example_zh: 野生动物保护需要每个人的帮助。

cards.example_en: He studies piano at a conservatory near the city centre.
cards.example_zh: 他在市中心附近的一所音乐学院学钢琴。

cards.example_en: Each consumer who tasted the new juice wrote a score on the card.
cards.example_zh: 每位品尝新果汁的消费者都在卡片上写了分数。

cards.example_en: Contact the teacher if you have a question.
cards.example_zh: 如果有问题，请联系老师。

cards.example_en: This box may contain fragile items.
cards.example_zh: 这个箱子可能装有易碎物品。

cards.example_en: The content of the note on the fridge surprised the whole family.
cards.example_zh: 冰箱上那张便条的内容让全家人都吃了一惊。

cards.example_en: The youngest contestant sang a folk song and won second prize.
cards.example_zh: 最年轻的参赛者唱了一首民歌，获得了二等奖。

cards.example_en: Our cookery class taught us how to make tomato egg noodles.
cards.example_zh: 我们的烹饪课教我们怎么做番茄鸡蛋面。

cards.example_en: A cormorant dived into the river and came up with a fish.
cards.example_zh: 一只鸬鹚潜入河里，衔着一条鱼浮了上来。

cards.example_en: She wore a historical costume on stage.
cards.example_zh: 她在台上穿着历史服装。

cards.example_en: The school counsellor helped him choose subjects for next year.
cards.example_zh: 学校辅导员帮他选定了明年的科目。

cards.example_en: Rain moved our tennis match onto the indoor court.
cards.example_zh: 一下雨，我们的网球赛就改到了室内球场。

cards.example_en: We ate steamed crab with ginger at the seafood restaurant.
cards.example_zh: 我们在海鲜餐厅吃了姜蒸螃蟹。

cards.example_en: Knotting bracelets is the craft we practise on rainy club days.
cards.example_zh: 编手链是我们在下雨的社团日练习的手艺。

cards.example_en: The bike did not crash into the wall.
cards.example_zh: 自行车没有撞到墙上。

cards.example_en: Colour the map with a crayon.
cards.example_zh: 用蜡笔给地图上色。

cards.example_en: Would you like cream in your coffee?
cards.example_zh: 你的咖啡要加奶油吗？

word.example_en: She is confident in her spoken English.
word.example_zh: 她对自己的英语口语有信心。
